summary: OpenAI announced that Uber is using its models to power AI assistants and voice features for drivers and riders across its marketplace.

mechanisms.reason: Deploying AI assistants and voice features across a global real-time marketplace implies incremental inference calls at scale.
mechanisms.quote: Uber uses OpenAI to power AI assistants and voice features that help drivers earn smarter and riders book faster across a global real-time marketplace.

categories.reason: A consumer marketplace platform is integrating AI assistant and voice capabilities into its core product.
categories.quote: Uber uses OpenAI to help people earn smarter and book faster.
